epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for local verification.

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization setup for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose configuration, so that the full stack can be launched locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local development environment, When the user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When a request is made to the health-check endpoint, Then a successful response is returned verifying system state.
Given the containerization setup, When verification is performed, Then integration tests validate the health-check endpoint.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment startup time from >15 minutes to <1 minute

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Provide frontend UI controls for updating materials.
R2: Provide frontend UI controls for deleting materials.

slices.title: Add update and delete material UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend management controls for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that users can manage existing materials through the UI.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user updates it via the UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user deletes it via the UI, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API and removes the material from the view.
Given the new UI controls, When tested, Then E2E tests verify the update and delete actions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete a material from >5 minutes to <1 minute

epics.title: System Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized data access incidents from >0 to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Intercept unauthenticated attempts to access the catalog.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in.

slices.title: Implement authentication and access block
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that restricted resources are protected from unauthorized requests.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then the action is rejected.
Given the authentication mechanism, When tested, Then integration tests verify the access block and login prompt.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce successful unauthenticated endpoint access from 100% to 0%
